props.name: exportName

props.name: rowTree
props.description: Tree rows: the table reads as an ARIA treegrid and rows carry aria-level and aria-expanded.

props.name: timeZone
props.description: Time zone of time columns: 'local' (default), 'utc' or an IANA name.

props.name: sortLocale
props.description: Locale for sorting text columns (Intl.Collator); follows the runtime when omitted.

props.name: collapseColumns
props.description: Priority columns (default true): at standard and hero emphasis, when the visible columns do not fit the container, the lowest-priority columns (GridColumn.priority; undeclared ones count up in declaration order) are collapsed and a "+N cols" capsule appears at the right end of the header; clicking it switches to horizontal scrolling with every column.

props.name: containerWidth

props.name: density
props.description: Row height tier.

props.name: hideHeader

props.name: headExtra
props.description: Extra content after the sort button in each column head (a search icon on the Symbol head, say): given per column id, null for none.

props.name: headEnd
props.description: Content at the far right of the header (the "+ add column" button, wired to ColumnPicker); floats over the header end and takes no column.

props.name: autoRowHeight
props.description: Row height follows the content (multi-line cells, buttons in rows): the density height is a minimum and the measured height wins; cell text may wrap.

props.name: ruled
props.description: Draw a thin rule between rows.

props.name: selectable
props.description: When false, clicking a row neither selects nor opens it and there is no hover tint; only keyboard movement and expanding remain (for tables of mostly buttons).

props.name: interactive
props.description: Interactive (default true): rows can be clicked, selected and moved with the keyboard, with a context menu.

props.name: stretch
props.description: Treat column widths as proportions: when the container is wider than the sum, the extra space is shared by width ratio; by default widths are fixed pixels.

props.name: fit
props.description: Height follows the content (a small table in a dialog): no scrollbar up to maxHeight px.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Largest height in px when fit is set.

props.name: live
props.description: Live data mode (default false): numeric cells (number, price, quantity, pnl, change) flash the up or down color when their value changes, rows glide to their new place when the sort order changes, and newly added rows are highlighted briefly.

props.name: rowOrder

props.name: onRowOrderChange

props.name: rowSection

props.name: classNames

props.name: matchKey

props.name: keysOf

props.description: 原始值，由类型决定怎么读：price / quantity / pnl / change / number / bar 是数字或十进制字符串（空、不是数写 —）； pill 是 PillValue 或 PillValue[]；progress 是 ProgressValue；streak 是板数或 StreakValue（A 股连板，#110）；limitStatus 是状态名或 { status, sealAmount, reason }； time 是毫秒时间戳；side 是 'buy' | 'sell'；symbol 是 SymbolValue；text 是字符串；custom 不读（内容全由 `cell` 画，要排序、复制就给 `text` 与 `sort`）。

props.name: text
props.description: 屏幕上的字；给了它就盖掉类型的写法（复制与导出的也是它）。

props.name: sort
props.description: 排序用的值：数字、十进制字符串或毫秒数；没有值给 undefined，排在最后。省略时用类型的原始值，再没有就用屏幕上的字。

props.name: tone
props.description: 字的颜色，盖掉类型的（pnl / change / side 默认按方向着色）。

props.name: fill
props.description: 整格的底色（ATAS 的盈亏是整格绿底 / 红底）。

props.name: heat
props.description: 强度底色：格子底色按这一格的数深浅（读 `value`）。domain 是 [最小, 最大]：跨 0 时正数用涨色、负数用跌色，各自以 0 到端点的距离定深浅； 不跨 0 时全按涨色、从最小到最大。rank 给了就在格子右上角写一个名次小字（不占行高行宽）。颜色只由 token 给，调用方不传色值。

props.name: cell
props.description: custom 列的内容：这一格画什么都行（多行的字、使用度条、按钮）。按钮之类要点的东西放在里面，表不把它当整行的点击。

props.name: render
props.description: 代替文字的内容（状态灯、置灰的入口）；复制与导出仍用屏幕上的字。

props.name: priority
